segments.note: Correction 002 (T-43): the T-42 map classed this body USER_ACCEPTANCE on a HOST_USER_TURN capture naming SRC-019 as the byte carrier. That claim is false -- SRC-019 does not contain these bytes, and no file in this repository does outside SRC-017 itself and the maps written about it. No carrier is mechanically available, the intake witness is model_supplied, and the Russian wording of the body is not authorship evidence. Authorship is therefore undetermined: AMBIGUOUS, carrying no authority, until a real operator carrier is verifiable under CAPTURE-PROOF-01.
